object.description: Accepted but not built. Open a document in the Document Editor, out of read-only mode. Change one of its object files from outside Mellon so the Changed on disk banner shows. Type a new description in the grid's cell editor without leaving the cell. From the Compare dialog compare the latest commit with the working copy. Repeat typing in the Inspector instead.
